visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two individuals sit on a modern sofa against a white wall with black circular patterns. A male with bright yellow-orange hair wears a blue and yellow striped shirt, holding his head in disappointment. A female with long red hair wears a white dress, looking at him with a neutral expression. (2) The red-haired female appears alone on the sofa, gesturing with her hands while speaking directly toward the camera, mimicking a professional news anchor's posture and facial expressions. (3) The scene returns to the pair; the female holds a smartphone to her ear, smiling while the yellow-haired male stands up and walks out of the frame toward the left with a dejected posture. (4) The duo is seated again; the male holds a clear water bottle and looks frustrated, while the female points at him and laughs heartily, her mouth wide open. (5) The yellow-haired male is alone on the sofa, holding a phone to his ear. He begins with a serious face and then transitions into intense, exaggerated laughter, throwing his head back. (6) A different couple appears: a female with reddish-brown hair in a grey dress and a male in a white polo shirt. She jumps and cheers excitedly, while the male remains seated, looking stern and lecturing her with a focused gaze.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic sketch satirizing the varied emotional responses and social situations people experience in Taiwan regarding 'Typhoon Holidays.' Through several exaggerated vignettes, it captures the frustration of canceled holidays, the mockery of friends in different cities, and the parental perspective on safety.
